verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes an API reference for Computer endpoints, such as the Analytics usage GET page under /api-reference/, backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json. This gives an AI-native user a structured reference to explore, but nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable request examples, broader reference coverage beyond the analytics endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
